In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the long-range TPE electromagnetic current contributions are important in the description of electromagnetic processes and that they are not negligible in the NLO chiral effective field theory (EFT).
the inclusion of the NLO electromagnetic TPE currents in the chiral EFT framework improves the description of the data.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are now able to describe the 2H photodisintegration cross section with a theoretical uncertainty which is comparable to the experimental one.
the chiral N2LO NN potential is a good tool for the description of the electromagnetic observables in 2H and the 3He photoreactions.
the chiral TPE currents provide a reasonable description of the 2H photodisintegration data and improve the agreement with the 3He data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the long-range TPE electromagnetic current is a necessary ingredient for a consistent description of the photodisintegrations of 2H (3He).
the long-range TPE electromagnetic current operator should be used as a part of the current operator in any future calculations of electromagnetic processes.
the NLO chiral TPE currents can be used to describe a variety of electromagnetic reactions and the N2LO NN potential is a good choice for the bound-state wave functions.
